title: significance-language-v1 player output
description: Flagged spans of interpretive-language problems in the excerpt. Each flag localises the offending phrase by character range, names its category, and carries a confidence. A correctly-written passage yields an empty flags list.

text.description: The flagged phrase, verbatim from the excerpt.

char_start.description: Inclusive character offset of the span start in input.text.

char_end.description: Exclusive character offset of the span end in input.text.

confidence.description: Player's confidence that this span is a genuine problem.
